plan: To prioritize capital preservation, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Trim SMH to 5% due to its downtrend and reduce SPY to 20% to meet concentration limits.
Increase QQQI to 25% for income focus and add CRM at 4% as a top-quality name.
This plan aims for a stable portfolio with reduced risk and a focus on income and broad market exposure.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation and lower drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, but growth potential is limited.

plan: For a balanced approach, sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SMH to 5% due to its downtrend and reduce SPY to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Buy SNOW at 4% and CRM at 4% to add high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan balances broad market exposure with quality tech and reduced leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding quality growth names, offering a moderate risk/reward profile.

plan: For aggressive growth, sell SOXL and SPAL to zero as they are below stops and have high losses.
Trim SMH to 5% due to its downtrend and reduce SPY to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Buy SNOW at 6% and HOOD at 6% to lean into high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan uses leverage from existing positions and concentrates in strong setups for higher growth potential.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It involves higher concentration and leverage, which amplifies both upside and potential drawdown. Daily decay of leveraged ETFs and strict stop discipline are critical.

plan: To prioritize income, sell SOXL and SPAL to zero, eliminating all leveraged ETFs.
Trim SMH to zero and CRWD to 5% to reduce high-beta and single-name exposure.
Increase QQQI to 30% and QQQ to 25% to rotate into income and broad index for steady distributions.
This plan focuses on low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. While aiming for cash-like income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff. Growth potential is minimal.
